description.zh:
业务类型
取值：
    FREEZE：用户冻结业务
    TRUSTEESHIP：用户托管业务
description.en:
The type of business operation. Valid values:
FREEZE: Freeze operations.
TRUSTEESHIP: Hosting operations.

description.zh:
需要设置的用户状态
取值：
    Freeze：用户冻结状态
    Thaw：用户解冻状态
    Trusteeship：用户托管状态
    TrusteeshipCancel：用户非托管状态
description.en:
The status to set for the user account. Valid values:
Freeze: The user account is frozen.
Thaw: The user account is restored.
Trusteeship: The user account is hosted.
TrusteeshipCancel: The user account is not hosted.

description.zh:
停机模式
取值：
    0：普通停机
    1：立即停机
description.en:
The stopping mode. Valid values:
0: Normal shutdown.
1: Immediate shutdown.

descriptions.zh: 根据上传参数设置托管、冻结状态。
descriptions.en: Sets the status of a reseller's user account, such as frozen or hosted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi set-reseller-user-status --status Freeze --business-type FREEZE --stop-mode 0 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi SetResellerUserStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status Freeze --BusinessType FREEZE --StopMode 0
